$comment: blurt colour, the single source of truth (docs/design/system.md). assets/color/build.py writes the Swift BrandColor, the CSS blocks and the AccentColor asset from this file, and `build.py --check` fails on stale outputs or a broken contrast floor. Colours are sRGB hex; an 8-digit hex carries alpha. `light` / `dark` follow the appearance; `island` is the always-dark chrome (notch island, capture chrome, overlays); `hc` (optional) is the Increase Contrast value. `min` is the contrast floor the colour must keep on every surface in `checks` of its appearance.

fill.use: mint: small fills that carry brand.on text (badge, size label, handle, clasp); marks on dark and over screen content. Never a line or text on a light surface.

ink.use: brand as text, icons, state rings, underlines and 1–2 pt lines on app surfaces

tint.use: pale mint wash: selected row, drop target, badge / chip background (18 % light, 16 % dark, 20 % island). Text on it stays neutral ink.

working.use: 'AI is working on this' (auto-sort, organising a batch, the Lab processing a take): one static 1 pt hairline just inside the working row's rounded edge, brand ink at 60 % light / 50 % dark. The spinner beside it carries the state; the line only says which row. Never rotating, never multi-colour, no halo.

on.use: text and glyphs on brand.fill and on the base gradient

onInk.use: rare: text on a brand.ink fill

accent.use: native controls (AccentColor asset, CSS accent-color): switch-on track, checkbox and radio fill, slider, focus ring, selection. Dark is a deeper mint than brand.fill so the white knob / check keeps ≥ 3:1 on it and the track keeps ≥ 3:1 on dark surfaces.

rec.use: recording is rolling: dot, frame, countdown ring, Stop. Never text (use err).

attn.use: needs you / paused / to verify: rings, dots, icons, the paused frame

ok.use: done / saved / applied. Always with a check shape.

onOk.use: the check on a success disc

err.use: error text and icons; destructive buttons use the system red

markup.use: the pen: strokes burned into screenshots (with a dark halo). Content, not UI.

kind.$comment: icon tints (and the review page's kind chip); floor 3:1 on checks.kindSurfaces too. A custom lens whose hashed HSL hue lands in customHueGap moves 60° on, so no lens reads as brand or success.

neutral.$comment: Reference only: the platform surfaces stay hand-written in web/packages/ui/src/tokens.css and native in AppKit.

gradient.$comment: Green → mint → azure; mint (brand.fill) is the seam. OKLab hues 147° / 175° / 237°. Stops are [name or hex, at]. Corner to corner = CSS `to bottom right`, CAGradientLayer start (0, 1) → end (1, 0) in an unflipped layer.

linear.use: the base gradient: the capture selection stroke, level bars (vertical) and the listening glow; dark text on it

button.use: primary buttons and Snap, with white bold text: the base hue path, deeper (OKLab L 0.55), so white reaches ≥ 4.5:1 at every point (≥ 4.0 on hover)

text.use: the onboarding title only (≥ 20 pt). Light uses the deeper variant (≥ 3:1 on light surfaces at every point); dark uses the base. Never body, labels, numbers or small text; flat ink under Increase Contrast.

spectrum.use: the onboarding hero art only (a still, blurred glow behind the mascot). Never on rows, banners, buttons, rims or celebrations.

field.use: large surfaces ≥ 64 pt: the app icon tile and the onboarding hero
field.$comment: layers bottom → top; centre and radius in fractions of the box (y down); stops [colour, alpha, at]

deep.use: the field in dark mode (onboarding hero) and the icon's dark appearance

grain.use: monochrome fractal noise, 2 octaves, contrast ×3, overlay blend; only on field / deep surfaces ≥ 64 pt; off with Reduce Transparency

glow.use: the island's listening aura: the base gradient, blurred. Only while blurt listens; off with Reduce Transparency.
